title: Activity Thread Annotator: annotated timelines, span tagging & correlation lens
creator: Marina Cho
description: Design and prototype an 'Activity Thread Annotator' for the Redwood Console tracing workspace. Goal: let operators and engineers rapidly annotate and surface important spans in a request timeline, correlate those annotations with rollout state and per-request cost data, and make correlation-id based filters first-class. The prototype should demonstrate: 1) inline span tagging and freeform annotations saved to the request snapshot; 2) a correlation lens panel that shows matching traces across services for selected correlation IDs; 3) a timeline annotation rail (release flags, rollout canary windows, cost-per-request heat overlay); 4) lightweight request summary cards that show cost, model variant, and rollout tag; 5) keyboard and screen-reader friendly timeline navigation. This ticket covers design flows, prototype in Figma, review with eng/pm, and a handoff package for implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype in Figma with interactive timeline scrubber and span tagging states
Correlation lens panel shows list of related traces when a correlation ID is selected
Cost overlay visualizes per-request token cost bands and can be toggled on/off
Rollout markers (canary, percentage changes) align to timeline and link to rollout record in Console
Design tokens and accessible color contrast documented for heat overlays
Handoff includes component spec, interaction states, and example API payloads for annotations
design_decisions: Use an annotation rail to avoid overcrowding the main timeline — annotations dock to the right and expand in-place
Treat span tags as mutable metadata saved on the request snapshot rather than altering the raw trace payload
Correlation lens queries will be limited to 1 minute of sampling by default to avoid expensive wide queries; provide 'expand scope' action for on-demand broader search
Cost overlay uses pre-aggregated per-request cost metric from backend to keep client rendering smooth; color bands map to quartiles rather than absolute cents
Rollout integration surfaces a 1-click deep link to the rollout detail page and a hover preview showing traffic weight history
implementation_notes: Front-end will reuse existing timeline renderer; add annotation layer canvas to avoid reflow on hover
Backend will expose /v1/annotations and attach snapshot_id; annotations are small JSON with author, timestamp, tag lists
Correlation lens endpoint will accept correlation_id + time_window + optional service_scope; results paginated and sample-weighted
Cost overlay will rely on new metrics stream (ENG-20345) — request-level smallest unit is token-block with cost micro-metrics
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: correlation queries become expensive — mitigation: default narrow window + sampling + query budget meter in UI
Risk: annotation data could be sensitive — mitigation: annotations respect snapshot privacy settings and inherit RBAC from snapshot
Risk: timeline becomes visually noisy with overlays — mitigation: provide layer toggles and condensed compact mode
